'''Mia Magansitty''' was a grandmother who resided on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:TemplateCommonerFemale.jpg|250px|thumb|Every possible depiction of Mia Magansitty]]
Mia Magansitty appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']]. Due to the nature of many older quests in the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the [[Species/Legends|species]] and appearance of Magansitty changed each time a player performed this quest. Therefore, it is impossible to verify the [[canon]]ical species of Magansitty. However, the quest dialogue given by [[Brennis Doore]] indicated that Magansitty was a female. She also consistently spawned as a female character.
